reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, category_id, launch_date
FROM products
WHERE category_id IN (15, 16, 24)
  AND product_name ILIKE '%pro%'
  AND launch_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-03-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
